after: This version uses a modified pipe-type layout. Several ordinary pipe cells use different pipe types from the base puzzle, creating an additional valid branch that may rejoin the Source-reachable network.
Because water may branch and rejoin in this version, all Source-reachable branches must be evaluated independently.
If water branches into multiple valid Source-reachable paths and those paths later rejoin, all actually reached branches are highlighted.

The changes above alter pipe types, not only orientations.
The modified V9 network may contain a Source-reachable branch that reconnects to another Source-reachable pipe.
A branch that later rejoins another valid Source-reachable pipe is not a Leak as long as every adjacent connection is bidirectionally valid.

before: The player's goal is to configure the fixed pipe network within at most 30 successful rotations so that Source water reaches both Sinks without producing any invalid Source-reachable outlet.
after: The player's goal is to configure the modified pipe network within at most 30 successful rotations so that Source water reaches both Sinks without producing any invalid Source-reachable outlet.
The modified pipe types can create branching and rejoining Source-reachable paths, and all such paths must satisfy the same bidirectional connection rules.
